subject.title: [Feature]: Catch up on missed inbound messages after gateway restart

question: Should OpenClaw implement missed inbound catch-up as a shared channel recovery contract, as provider-specific opt-in fixes for Slack/Discord, or defer provider-history replay until more live evidence is available?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow bug patch: it changes channel history/API usage, replay idempotency, read scopes, restart defaults, and config surface across provider-owned plugins.

options.title: Design a shared recovery contract
options.body: Add a typed SDK/plugin recovery seam first, then implement Slack and Discord with provider-owned cursors, dedupe, policy checks, and replay limits.

options.title: Narrow to provider-owned opt-ins
options.body: Implement Slack and Discord separately behind explicit per-provider configuration, accepting some duplicated policy until the shape proves itself.

options.title: Defer provider-history replay
options.body: Keep only current iMessage, Telegram, and queue-drain mitigations until maintainers have live Slack/Discord restart proof and a clearer default policy.

recommendation.title: Design a shared recovery contract
recommendation.body: Add a typed SDK/plugin recovery seam first, then implement Slack and Discord with provider-owned cursors, dedupe, policy checks, and replay limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans restart recovery, channel ownership, config defaults, and current ClawSweeper routing signals, and steipete has recent/current history on the implicated restart paths.
